item.title: Sky Bet League Two: Swindon gain ground on Bromley with comeback win
item.description: On an evening where many sides in the top half of the Sky Bet League Two table dropped points, Swindon Town picked up a vital win on the road at Barnet. The hosts opened the scoring through Adam Senior's fierce strike into the top corner, but Ollie Clarke's brace helped Ian Holloway's side to victory, closing the gap to league leaders Bromley to three points. item.description: League One title challengers Cardiff City and Lincoln City solidified their credentials on Tuesday night, with both sides hitting four goals on their way to wins. item.title: Sky Bet Championship: Max Bird's stunner denies Wrexham
item.description: Tuesday night in the Sky Bet Championship saw a clash between two promotion chasers in Bristol City and Wrexham. Ashton Gate witnessed some fantastic goals as fans were treated to a four-goal thriller, the pick of which was Max Bird's late equaliser for the home side. Ollie Rathbone had given Wrexham a first-half lead, cancelled out by Sinclair Armstrong's smart strike just two minutes after the break. item.title: County Stars participants build a life together through inclusive football
item.description: When James and Amy first met at Stockport County Community Trust’s County Stars Pan Disability football session, neither of them imagined that a routine training evening would shape the rest of their lives. What began as two young players sharing the pitch has grown into a marriage, a family, and a long‑standing connection to the County Stars community.
